meta.description: Versioned clinical thresholds and quality constraints for contactless multimodal neurological monitoring decision support.

lighting.instruction: Please reposition towards better lighting or avoid direct glare behind you.

facial_visibility.instruction: Please ensure your entire face is directly facing the camera at eye level.

postural_framing.instruction: Position yourself so your upper torso, shoulders, and hands are visible in the frame.

audio_snr.instruction: Move to a quieter room and speak clearly into the microphone.

emergency_fast_protocol.banner_text: CRITICAL HEALTH ALERT: Possible acute neurological indicators observed. Seek emergency medical attention immediately (e.g., dial 911 / emergency services). Do not wait for further assessments.
